title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Eighth edition, Volume 6, Burning glasses-Climate - EB.16
text: Where the quantity of arsenic present is very small, the method of Marsh, in which it is converted into arsenuerated hydrogen, must be employed the more delicate and the most certain. We shall describe this presetency under the heat of arsenimected hydrogen.
